newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down, seen bearish.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down, seen bearish.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed lower on Monday amid thin trading and are likely to open bearish on Tuesday, dealers said.
They said trading volume fell as major players, depressed by political and economic uncertainty, kept to the sidelines.
"The sentiment is likely to remain bearish as there is no positive news," dealer Shakeel Anwar said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 6.69 points, or 0.48 percent, to end at 1,385.06. Losers led gainers 127 to 100. Turnover fell to 11.35 million shares from 17.85 million on Sunday.

Faysal Bank fell 0.15 to 20.25 rupees but Adamjee Insurance rose 1.0 to 85. Hub Power Co fell 0.70 to 30.50, Pakistan State Oil 1.0 to 332, but Shell Pakistan rose 2.0 130. PTCL rose 0.05 to 33.45 and ICI 0.20 to 16.90. Fauji Fertilizer fell 0.90 to 69.
